summary: Badger Meter Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose an amendment and extension of its existing $150 million multi-currency revolving credit facility, with a new maturity date of July 8, 2031. No amounts were outstanding at the time. Borrowings bear interest at Term SOFR, Adjusted EURIBO, or Daily Simple SONIA plus 87.5 bps. Financial covenants require a Consolidated Net Debt to EBITDA ratio not greater than 3.00x and an interest coverage ratio of at least 3.00x. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation, as it involves no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change. The filing is a standard amendment and extension of a credit agreement.
